KNOWN_PREFILLS.whyNotSyntheticValues: The verdict's own repair note asked for an offence description and a Louisiana statutory citation to be supplied, and the Arizona family it compares against does carry one. This lane did not supply either, because the assignment forbids inventing and no committed record under data/record-clearing/ supplies an offence or a statute for art. 987. Writing a Louisiana criminal statute into the fixture would have been this lane authoring a case fact no record holds, onto a motion that asks a court to set aside a conviction. The assignment's own fallback - a declared, disclosed participant blank with its printed caption where a fact is genuinely not held - is what was used instead. This is recorded as a tension rather than settled: LA.memo.json's primary_filing component note says LegalEase completes 'the offence and statute' among the neutral case fields, which describes the runtime product where the participant's answer is in hand. It is not satisfied by a fixture that declares no answer. Closing that gap by giving the fixture court record an offence needs a legal-design record, which is not a repair lane's to write.
